p: his clothes rent: Seeming to lament the overthrow of the people of Israel.
As I happened by chance upon: As I fled the chase.
Amalekite: He was an Amalekite born, but renounced his country and joined with the Israelites.
life is yet whole in me: I am sorry, because I am yet alive.
And David said unto the young: After the lamentation, he examined him again.
Thy blood be upon thy head: You are justly punished for your fault.
the use of the bow: That they might be able to match their enemies the Philistines in that art.
slain upon thy high places: Meaning Saul.
fields of offerings: Let their fertile fields be barren, and bring forth no fruit to offer to the Lord.
divided: They died both together in Gilboa.
with other delights: As rich garments and costly jewels.
women: Either toward their husbands or their children.
